description: Meta service health, replication lag and storage bottlenecks. Summary cards cover one entire cluster; Node details filters the table and diagnostic charts. Independent from the Data node dashboard.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Unreachable or failed scrapes among configured Meta targets. Target count is not Raft voter membership.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_raft_leader_authority{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) ((sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_source_available{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",source="raft"}) == on (cluster) count by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) (min by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1))

panels.title: Raft leaders
panels.description: Members reporting usable local Raft authority. Expected: one. Unknown when any target or Raft source is unavailable; this is not a quorum certificate.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_data_control_eligible{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) ((sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_source_available{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",source="data_control"}) == on (cluster) count by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) (min by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1))

panels.title: Control eligible
panels.description: Members eligible to serve Data-control. Expected: one after leader readiness. Unknown with incomplete target/source coverage.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(lavik_meta_proposal_duration_seconds_bucket{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on (cluster) ((sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_source_available{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",source="proposal"}) == on (cluster) count by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) (min by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1))

panels.title: Proposal P99
panels.description: Cluster P99 from merged histogram buckets, not an average of node quantiles. Entry through first caller result, including queueing and all outcomes.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (rate(lavik_meta_proposals_total{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster) ((sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_source_available{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",source="proposal"}) == on (cluster) count by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) (min by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1))

panels.title: Proposals / s
panels.description: First caller completions across the entire cluster, including rejected and unknown outcomes. Not a Raft log-entry commit rate.

targets.expr: (max by (cluster) (clamp_min(lavik_meta_raft_commit_index{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"} - lavik_meta_raft_applied_index{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}, 0))) and on (cluster) ((sum by (cluster) (lavik_meta_source_available{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",source="raft"}) == on (cluster) count by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on (cluster) (min by (cluster) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster"}) == 1))

panels.title: Max apply lag
panels.description: Largest local committed-minus-actually-applied entry gap. Unknown with incomplete target/source coverage. Inspect the trend before interpreting a transient gap.

Pending and firing rule counts for the selected Meta cluster. Node details does not narrow cluster alerts. These are Prometheus states, including inhibited/silenced notifications, not evidence of delivered notifications. Zero active samples is not proof of health; check reachability and source coverage.

panels.title: Current Alerts
panels.description: Pending and firing alerts for the entire selected Meta cluster, with peer/stage scope and links to its runbook and metric panels. Node details does not hide cluster alerts. Active for includes pending time and the recovery hold. Inhibited/silenced notifications remain visible. No data is not proof of health.

panels.title: Meta nodes
panels.description: One row per configured target. Sort or filter columns, or click a node to focus the charts. Down targets remain visible; their runtime fields are unknown. Protocol role and serving authority are separate. Sources requires all local metric sources.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) ((lavik_meta_phase{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",phase="starting"} * 1 or lavik_meta_phase{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",phase="recovering"} * 2 or lavik_meta_phase{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",phase="running"} * 3 or lavik_meta_phase{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",phase="stopping"} * 4) and on (cluster, instance) (up{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"} == 1))

panels.title: Proposal outcomes
panels.description: First caller results. Unknown outcomes include post-submission timeout, cancellation and demotion. Late commit does not create a second result.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, instance, le) (rate(lavik_meta_proposal_duration_seconds_bucket{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, instance) (sum by (cluster, instance) (rate(lavik_meta_proposal_duration_seconds_count{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Proposal latency P99
panels.description: End-to-end caller latency, including queueing. This is not isolated Raft commit latency.

panels.title: Proposals in flight
panels.description: Caller proposals still waiting for their first result. Persistent growth indicates stalled progress or admission pressure.

panels.title: Local apply lag
panels.description: Committed entries minus completed C++ application. Sustained growth points to application work falling behind; a brief gap is normal.

panels.title: Peer replication and apply lag
panels.description: Leader commit index minus peer Match or valid peer applied index. Match is replication progress, not application. Expired peer-applied is absent, never zero.

panels.title: Peer heartbeat evidence age
panels.description: Compare evidence age with the local validity window. This is heartbeat proof age, not network RTT. Missing evidence is unknown.

panels.title: WAL and persistence P99
panels.description: WAL synchronization and the complete ordered executor task are overlapping timing layers; do not add them. Snapshot file preparation is separate.

panels.title: Persistence and snapshot failures
panels.description: Cumulative failure counters shown as rates. Fail-stop may prevent the last error scrape; target-down then supplies the evidence.

panels.title: Pending durability and retained log
panels.description: Pending bytes reveal durability backlog. Retained bytes are logical log size, not filesystem consumption.

panels.title: Persistence and snapshot in-flight age
panels.description: Elapsed age of active executor work. Reveals stuck work that has not yet produced a duration sample.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, instance, stage, le) (rate(lavik_meta_raft_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="lavik-meta",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",stage=~"capture|install|prepare|publish"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Snapshot stage P99
panels.description: Capture/install cover C++ and encoding/decoding; prepare includes file rename and directory sync; publish completes durable publication.

panels.title: Snapshot and GC consecutive failures
panels.description: Failure streaks reset after success. The failure-rate panel retains the cumulative history.

panels.title: Transport failures
panels.description: Connect/read/write errors and send-queue rejections. Zero log or snapshot connections alone is normal and is not a health signal.

panels.title: Busiest send queue
panels.description: Maximum queue occupancy across current peers, per node and lane. Excludes the current socket write. Use the instance filter to investigate a busy node.

panels.title: Active Data-control sessions
panels.description: Current sessions on Meta nodes. Compare with Control eligible and expected Data-node connections.

panels.title: Data-control session outcomes
panels.description: Outcomes across selected nodes. Redirects during leader changes are expected; sustained rejection or protocol errors need investigation.

panels.title: Collection average duration
panels.description: Completed prior collections; the current HTTP scrape is excluded from its own observation.

panels.title: Collection failures
panels.description: Failed collection returns HTTP 503. Prometheus up=0 also covers deadline, network and fail-stop failures.
